# next snapshot lane: unexpected refusal or publish failure
_Swept 2026-11-11T01:24:44.384Z · [run log](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/42938356503) · started by the daily schedule · candidate commit `c0d64068aaa818552a30319a188d7e7e6b1b5da1` · case `refusal`._
The `next` snapshot lane of `release.yml` (ADR-0125, amendments of 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06) proposes a
snapshot of `main` once a day and publishes it only on the maintainer's approval. GitHub mails a scheduled
run's failure to the cron's author, never to the maintainer, so this card is the lane's one reader of its
two failures: an unexpected preflight refusal, and a publish that failed after the approval. A success files
nothing; an expected refusal is a quiet skip and files nothing. The body is rewritten in place on every
refresh, so it always describes the newest failing run.
## An UNEXPECTED preflight refusal
The preflight refused for a reason that is none of the five expected ones (the candidate already on `next`,
an RC cycle, a fixed-group member not yet on npm, no fully green commit on `main`, a stable prompt waiting or
a stable publish running -- each of those is a quiet skip on the schedule and files nothing). Nothing was
queued at the `release` environment and nothing was published.
- Reason: stable lane NOT MEASURED -- listing release.yml's in_progress runs: total_count 2 but 1 listed, so the rest are unread
⛔ The remedy is never to loosen the preflight so the run goes green. Read the reason, fix what it names,
and let the next day's run refresh this card.
